name: Christchurch International Airport

curfew.v: No curfew: the airport operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
curfew.quote: Christchurch Airport is one of only two airports in New Zealand that can operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

hours.quote: Christchurch Airport is required to operate 24 hours a day to support the economy of the region and New Zealand.

customs.v: Christchurch is a Customs Place and MPI Place of First Arrival. Arrival must be in working hours; outside working hours needs approval at least 5 working days ahead. Passenger details to Customs at least 3 hours before departure. Working hours are not stated.
customs.quote: If you are arriving outside of working hours, you must get approval at least 5 working days in advance.

notes: AIP New Zealand could not be read (AD 2 PDFs return only the conditions-of-use page), so no runway data. 24-hour operation from Christchurch Airport's own noise page (no edition date). The airport is open 24 hours, but NZ Customs still wants arrivals in working hours unless approved 5 working days ahead.
